# IBPS & SBI Banking (PO & Clerk) Comprehensive Examination Blueprint & All-Subject Practice Guide

## 1. Conducting Authority & Examination Architecture
- **Conducting Bodies**: Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) & State Bank of India (SBI).
- **Official Web Portals**: ibps.in & sbi.co.in/careers
- **Examination Cadres**:
  - IBPS CRP PO/MT (Probationary Officers / Management Trainees across Public Sector Banks)
  - IBPS CRP Clerical Cadre (Customer Support Associates)
  - SBI PO (Probationary Officers) & SBI Clerk (Junior Associates)
- **Examination Stages**:
  - Preliminary Examination (Objective CBT: 100 Questions, 100 Marks, 60 Minutes with 20-minute sectional timing)
  - Main Examination (Objective CBT + Descriptive Test for PO: 200 Marks + 25 Marks Descriptive)
  - Psychometric Test & Group Exercise / Interview (for PO cadre).

## 2. Examination Scheme & Marking Rules
- **Marking Formula**: **+1.0 Mark** per correct response, **-0.25 Marks (1/4th penalty)** per wrong answer.
- **Sectional Cut-offs**: Mandatory sectional qualifying marks enforced in IBPS examinations.
- **Sectional Timing**: Fixed 20-minute time lock per section in Prelims preventing inter-sectional switching.

## 3. Multi-Subject Sampling (50% Representative Coverage)
- **Quantitative Aptitude & Data Interpretation**: 150 Questions
- **Reasoning Ability & Puzzles**: 150 Questions
- **English Language & Verbal Ability**: 150 Questions
- **General / Banking / Financial Awareness**: 150 Questions
- **Total Sampled Practice Questions**: 600 Questions

## 4. High-Yield Practice Excerpts

**Q1 [ibps-banking-quantitative-aptitude | ID: ibps-bank-quantitative-aptitude-0001]**
- (EN): Two quadratic equations are given: (I) x^2 - 11x + 30 = 0 and (II) y^2 - 15y + 56 = 0. What is the relation between x and y? (Quant Problem #1)
- (HI): दो द्विघात समीकरण दिए गए हैं: (I) x^2 - 11x + 30 = 0 और (II) y^2 - 15y + 56 = 0। x और y के बीच क्या संबंध है? (संख्यात्मक अभियोग्यता प्रश्न #1)
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q2 [ibps-banking-quantitative-aptitude | ID: ibps-bank-quantitative-aptitude-0002]**
- (EN): Find the missing number in the sequence: 12, 14, 30, 94, 382, ____? (Quant Problem #2)
- (HI): दी गई संख्या श्रृंखला में लुप्त संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए: 12, 14, 30, 94, 382, ____? (संख्यात्मक अभियोग्यता प्रश्न #2)
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q3 [ibps-banking-quantitative-aptitude | ID: ibps-bank-quantitative-aptitude-0003]**
- (EN): A sum of Rs. 16,000 invested at 10% compound interest compounded annually amounts to Rs. 21,296 in how many years? (Quant Problem #3)
- (HI): 16,000 रुपये की राशि 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज की दर से कितने वर्षों में 21,296 रुपये हो जाएगी? (संख्यात्मक अभियोग्यता प्रश्न #3)
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q4 [ibps-banking-quantitative-aptitude | ID: ibps-bank-quantitative-aptitude-0004]**
- (EN): A and B can complete a banking software audit in 12 days and 18 days respectively. With C's help, they finish it in 4 days. In how many days can C alone complete the entire work? (Quant Problem #4)
- (HI): A और B किसी बैंकिंग सॉफ्टवेयर ऑडिट को क्रमशः 12 दिन और 18 दिन में पूरा कर सकते हैं। C की सहायता से वे इसे 4 दिन में पूरा करते हैं। C अकेला इस कार्य को कितने दिनों में पूरा करेगा? (संख्यात्मक अभियोग्यता प्रश्न #4)
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q5 [ibps-banking-quantitative-aptitude | ID: ibps-bank-quantitative-aptitude-0005]**
- (EN): A merchant marks up his goods by 40% above the cost price and allows a cash discount of 15%. What is his overall profit percentage? (Quant Problem #5)
- (HI): एक व्यापारी अपने माल पर क्रय मूल्य से 40% अधिक अंकित करता है और 15% की नकद छूट देता है। उसका कुल लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है? (संख्यात्मक अभियोग्यता प्रश्न #5)
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

- (HI): 80 kg के मिश्रधातु में तांबे और जस्ते का अनुपात 5:3 है। अनुपात को 5:4 करने के लिए इसमें कितना जस्ता मिलाया जाना चाहिए? (संख्यात्मक अभियोग्यता प्रश्न #6)
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

- (HI): 72 km/h की गति से चल रही 240 मीटर लंबी ट्रेन एक प्लेटफॉर्म को 22 सेकंड में पार करती है। प्लेटफॉर्म की लंबाई क्या है? (संख्यात्मक अभियोग्यता प्रश्न #7)

- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q9 [ibps-banking-quantitative-aptitude | ID: ibps-bank-quantitative-aptitude-0009]**

# RBI Policy, Banking Regulations & Indian Financial Economy Complete Master Digest

## 1. Key Banking Regulatory Frameworks
- **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**: Established April 1, 1935 under RBI Act 1934; nationalised January 1, 1949.
- **Monetary Policy Committee (MPC)**: 6 members (3 RBI + 3 GoI). Targets CPI inflation at 4% with a tolerance band of +/- 2%.
- **Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) Corridor**:
  - Ceiling: Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) & Bank Rate (Repo + 25 bps)
  - Benchmark: Policy Repo Rate
  - Floor: Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) (Repo - 25 bps).
- **Capital Adequacy (Basel III)**: Minimum CRAR 9.0% + 2.5% Capital Conservation Buffer (CCB) = 11.5% for scheduled commercial banks.
- **Priority Sector Lending (PSL)**: 40% of ANBC for domestic banks (Agriculture 18%, Micro Enterprises 7.5%, Weaker Sections 12%).

## 2. High-Yield Practice Excerpts

**Q1 [ibps-banking-general-financial-awareness | ID: ibps-bank-general-financial-awareness-0001]**

- (HI): भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक अधिनियम, 1934 के तहत मौद्रिक नीति समिति (MPC) में कितने सदस्य होते हैं? (बैंकिंग जागरूकता प्रश्न #1)
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

## 3. High-Scoring Verbal Principles
- **Subject-Verb Agreement**: Collective nouns like 'Board of Directors', 'Monetary Policy Committee' take singular verbs when functioning unanimously.
- **Parallelism**: Ensure grammatical elements joined by conjunctions (and, but, or) share matching grammatical structures.
- **Vocabulary in Context**: Master financial nuances of words like Solvency, Liquidity, Moratorium, Amortization, Fiduciary, Volatility, Fiscal, and Monetary.
